chunks: Yet man says: 'When I am dead, will I come to life again?'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about man's disbelief in resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the psychological state of the disbeliever who, despite witnessing daily creation, doubts the power of Allah to recreate the broken bones. It underscores the theme of *al-Ba'th* (Resurrection) as a logical necessity of Divine power, contrasting human arrogance with the certainty of the Hereafter. The verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to those who view death as an absolute end rather than a transition.
